items.title: Actual Gibbs position moment about a stationary point

source.anchor: Lemma4.2,equation(4.6) final standardized-potential position moment; source C2/Hessian setting(1.1)
source.attribution: ASTIS original proof of the position-moment component needed by Fan Chen,Sinho Chewi,Jianfeng Lu and Matthew S. Zhang,Smoothed Picard Hamiltonian Monte Carlo;not a verbatim theorem or the complete Lemma4.2.

items.statement: The actual mu is a probability measure. The function exp(-U) is integrable against volume and its integral Z is strictly positive. Both norm(x-p)^2 and inner(x-p,gradient U(x)) are integrable against mu. Their actual integrals satisfy integral inner(x-p,gradient U(x)) dmu=d and integral norm(x-p)^2 dmu<=d/alpha.
assumptions: E is a finite-dimensional real inner-product Borel space,with its complete metric structure; d=dim_R E may be zero. Volume is its canonical Lebesgue measure.

alpha and beta are nonnegative real numbers,0<alpha and alpha<=beta. U:E->R is twice continuously Frechet differentiable. For every x,v,alpha*norm(v)^2<=D2U(x)[v,v]<=beta*norm(v)^2. The derivatives and gradient are genuine derivatives of U.

p is any supplied point of E satisfying gradient U(p)=0. Existence of a stationary point is not concluded by this theorem. Set Z=integral exp(-U(x)) dx and mu=volume.tilted(-U); the tilt is the actual normalized exponential measure,not an arbitrary probability law.
All displayed real integrals are Bochner integrals. Integrability is proved explicitly; no moment bound or vanishing boundary term is supplied.

obligations.label: Actual Gibbs position moment about a stationary point

bindings.boundary: Actual normalized volume.tilted(-U),genuine C2 lower/upper Hessian bounds and an explicitly supplied actual stationary point p. The proof establishes normalization,L1,exact position-gradient moment and sharp dimension/curvature bound. General p,positive alpha,finite beta,coordinate-free and zero-dimensional spaces are disclosed extensions. It is not a weakest-hypothesis strong-log-concavity theorem. The source consumer has standardized potential norm(u)^2/2+rho_y(u),p=0,alpha=1,beta=1+eta;stationarity follows from cancellation of the defining linear term. Identification with the affine image of the actual RGO needs the proximal equation and a separate measure-transport proof. No Gaussian transport-Fisher,smoothed-score identity,estimator bias,Picard accuracy,initialization or query-cost theorem is asserted.

assumption_deltas.lean: Finite-dimensional real inner-product Borel space including dimension zero.
assumption_deltas.reason: The empty-basis case is proved;no infinite-dimensional statement.

assumption_deltas.source: Source standardized potential has lower curvature1 and upper curvature1+eta.
assumption_deltas.lean: Genuine C2 Hessian bounds0<alpha<=beta with arbitrary finite beta.
assumption_deltas.reason: Source consumer satisfies this contract;the proof is not advertised as a weakest-hypothesis theorem.

assumption_deltas.source: The source potential is centered at its stationary point zero.
assumption_deltas.lean: An arbitrary actual stationary point p is explicitly supplied.
assumption_deltas.reason: Stationarity is not assumed of an unrelated reference point and existence is not claimed;the source zero-point cancellation remains a separate adapter.

assumption_deltas.source: Source (4.6) uses the standardized actual RGO law.
assumption_deltas.lean: The measure here is actual volume.tilted(-U).
assumption_deltas.reason: The affine RGO identification is still required;it needs the proximal equation and measure transport.

assumption_deltas.source: Source needs the bound E norm(u)^2<=d.
assumption_deltas.lean: The theorem proves the exact pairing moment d and position bound d/alpha.
assumption_deltas.reason: At alpha=1 the numerical source constant1 is preserved;beta does not enter the final bound.

assumption_deltas.source: Full-space integrals and IBP underlie the source moment step.
assumption_deltas.lean: Exponential L1,positive normalizer,position/pairing L1 and coordinate IBP are proved.
assumption_deltas.reason: No integrability,boundary disappearance or moment identity is a supplied closure assumption.

assumption_deltas.source: Lemma4.2 also needs Gaussian transport-Fisher and actual score bias.
assumption_deltas.lean: Only the actual Gibbs position-moment component is proved.
assumption_deltas.reason: No full bias theorem,Picard accuracy,initialization or expected query cost is claimed.
